SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH cohort AS (SELECT id, created_at FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'), o AS (SELECT c.id, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS n FROM cohort c JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = c.id AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at >= c.created_at AND oi.created_at < c.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY c.id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS cohort_size, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2) AS repeaters, ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n >= 2)::numeric / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort)), 4) AS share FROM o

WITH u AS (SELECT id, traffic_source FROM public.users WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'),
r AS (SELECT oi.user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS rev FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT u.traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(r.rev,0))::numeric,2) AS rev, ROUND((SUM(COALESCE(r.rev,0))/COUNT(*))::numeric,4) AS rev_per_user, ROUND((SUM(r.rev)/NULLIF(COUNT(r.user_id),0))::numeric,4) AS rev_per_buyer FROM u LEFT JOIN r ON r.user_id=u.id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at))/3600.0) AS median_hours, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(delivered_at) AS nd FROM public.order_items WHERE status = 'Complete' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

WITH rev AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue FROM public.order_items WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS users, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.net_revenue),0)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue FROM public.users u LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH o AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) t FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.users u ON u.id=oi.user_id WHERE u.traffic_source='Facebook' AND u.created_at>='2024-01-01' AND u.created_at<'2025-01-01' AND oi.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT user_id, t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t, order_id) rn FROM o), d AS (SELECT a.user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.t-a.t)/86400.0 days, b.t::date-a.t::date dd FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.user_id=b.user_id AND a.rn=1 AND b.rn=2) SELECT COUNT(*), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) med, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dd) med_date FROM d

WITH c AS (SELECT u.id, TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at),'YYYY-MM') m, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.user_id=u.id AND oi.status<>'Cancelled' AND oi.created_at>=u.created_at AND oi.created_at<u.created_at+INTERVAL '30 days') conv FROM public.users u WHERE u.created_at>='2024-01-01' AND u.created_at<'2025-01-01') SELECT m, COUNT(*) n, AVG(conv::int::double precision) share FROM c GROUP BY m ORDER BY share DESC

WITH o AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS t FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.users u ON u.id=oi.user_id WHERE u.traffic_source='Facebook' AND u.created_at>='2024-01-01' AND u.created_at<'2025-01-01' AND oi.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT user_id, t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t, order_id) rn FROM o)
SELECT COUNT(*) n, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r3.t-r2.t)/86400) med_days
FROM r r2 JOIN r r3 ON r3.user_id=r2.user_id AND r2.rn=2 AND r3.rn=3

WITH u AS (SELECT user_id, SUM(sale_price) AS spend FROM public.order_items WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY user_id) SELECT ROUND((percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spend))::numeric, 2) AS p90, COUNT(*) FROM u

WITH o AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS ts FROM public.order_items oi JOIN public.users u ON u.id=oi.user_id WHERE u.traffic_source='Organic' AND u.created_at>='2024-01-01' AND u.created_at<'2025-01-01' AND oi.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT user_id, ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) rn FROM o),
d AS (SELECT a.user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.ts-a.ts)/86400.0 AS days FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.user_id=b.user_id AND a.rn=1 AND b.rn=2)
SELECT COUNT(*), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) AS med, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY floor(days)) AS med_int FROM d

WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS ts, SUM(sale_price) AS val FROM public.order_items WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) AS rn FROM o) SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY val) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS first_med, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY val) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS repeat_med, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY val) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) - PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY val) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS diff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS n_rep FROM r

WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, order_id, MIN(created_at) AS ts FROM public.order_items WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2), r AS (SELECT user_id, ts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY ts, order_id) rn FROM o), d AS (SELECT a.user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.ts - a.ts))/86400.0 AS days FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.user_id=b.user_id AND a.rn=1 AND b.rn=2) SELECT COUNT(*), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) p95, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY floor(days)) p95_int FROM d

WITH u AS (SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source='Search' AND created_at>='2024-01-01' AND created_at<'2025-01-01'),
o AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) t FROM public.order_items oi JOIN u ON u.id=oi.user_id WHERE oi.status<>'Cancelled' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT user_id, t, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t, order_id) rn FROM o),
d AS (SELECT a.user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM b.t-a.t)/86400.0 days, b.t::date-a.t::date ddays FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.user_id=b.user_id AND a.rn=1 AND b.rn=2)
SELECT COUNT(*), PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days) med, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ddays) med_date FROM d
